title: Spotify stays connected while its grant is alive, and a failed refresh is retryable unless the grant is dead (packet 3)
acceptance: C-1, web: a Spotify connection whose access token has expired is still 'connected' everywhere the SPA reads connection state (providerConnectionState in apps/web/src/lib/providers.ts): Live preflight and the coordinator, Music, Connections, Songs and the builder no longer show Spotify as 'Session expired' or ask to reconnect just because an hour passed. The server already refreshes on use (mintSpotifyPlaybackToken, user-likes, user-playlists). Apple Music's expiry handling is unchanged (D27); SoundCloud's existing exemption stays. The coordinator test that expects an expired Spotify connection to be no_connected_provider is updated to the new contract.

C-2, package: the Spotify token endpoint failure (packages/music/src/spotify-oauth.ts postToken) throws a typed error that keeps the HTTP status and the OAuth error code (for example invalid_grant), without the response body text or any token.

C-2, API: one shared helper classifies a failed refresh in all three places that refresh (spotify-playback-token.ts, user-likes.ts, user-playlists.ts). A dead grant (400/401, invalid_grant, a missing or undecryptable refresh token) stays 409 REAUTH_REQUIRED. A Spotify 5xx or a network failure becomes the retryable 502 provider error, and a 429 becomes the retryable 429. Neither starts OAuth.

C-2, web: a retryable failure from the playback-token request during a Spotify start or the SDK's token callback shows a retryable playback error (Live's existing Retry path), never a Reconnect Spotify prompt; REAUTH_REQUIRED and PLAYBACK_REAUTH_REQUIRED keep their current messages.

Tests: docs/audits/codex-code-audit-2026-10-27-4e0b150/repro/c-web-playback-repro.test.ts and c-api-token-refresh-repro.test.ts are adapted to the new contract and pass as unit or integration tests in the repo's suites. Integration tests drive the playback-token route against a fake token endpoint for 400 invalid_grant, 500, 503, 429 and a thrown fetch.

Contract: the OpenAPI entry for GET /providers/spotify/playback-token documents the 502 and 429 responses, regenerated with no drift. The PR tells the Neo, because the native Mac Live uses this route and should treat 502/429 as retry, not reconnect.

Owner browser check on desktop Chrome with Spotify Premium, after a deploy: (1) leave Ritmo and Spotify unused for at least 65 minutes, then open a Spotify-only class: Music and Connections show Spotify Connected, Live preflight passes and Start class is audible within a few seconds with no Reconnect prompt; (2) run a class across the hour mark from the last Spotify use and confirm music keeps playing through it; (3) remove Ritmo in Spotify's account 'Manage apps', then Start a Spotify class: Ritmo asks to reconnect Spotify. Retryable failures (Spotify 5xx/429, network) are proved by tests only; they cannot be forced on production.
nextAction: Proposed by RF-92 (Air, 2026-11-12) as audit packet 3. Waits for the owner to agree this scope and set Ready. Owner-gated (provider and playback code). Likely files: packages/music/src/spotify-oauth.ts, packages/music/src/errors.ts, apps/api/src/lib/music/{spotify-playback-token,user-likes,user-playlists}.ts plus a shared refresh-failure helper, apps/web/src/lib/providers.ts, apps/web/src/lib/playback/{coordinator,spotify-adapter}.ts and their tests, apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts. Needs a deploy for the owner's check.
